title: Policy Administration Platform Modernization
opportunity_summary: Move a 15-year-old on-premises policy administration system (Java monolith, Oracle 12c, 47 Control-M batch jobs, 23 SOAP services) to Azure before a data-centre lease expires in Q3 2028, shorten the overnight batch window, and add a policyholder self-service portal. Phased migration required; claims adjudication stays in Guidewire ClaimCenter.
requested_by: Ingrid Solberg, Director of IT Portfolio, Halvard Mutual Insurance Group

demo_change.description: The customer decides to open the self-service portal to the full policyholder base at first release instead of existing online users only. Expected monthly active users rise from 5,000 to 500,000.
